findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: credits_checkout, request_data, guru_moves · Private data: keys_create, pricing, request_data, ai_context, research, intrinsic_value, as_filed, brief, smart_money_holdings, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, verdict, mirror_brief, gurus, guru, guru_portfolio, theses, indicators_buffett, indicators_shiller_pe, sentiment, news, companies_search, company_overview, fundamentals, filings · Public sink: keys_create, credits_checkout, request_data, intrinsic_value, brief, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, webhooks_list · Destructive: ai_context, research, intrinsic_value, brief, theses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: credits_checkout, request_data, guru_moves · Private data: keys_create, pricing, request_data, ai_context, research, intrinsic_value, as_filed, brief, smart_money_holdings, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, verdict, mirror_brief, gurus, guru, guru_portfolio, theses, indicators_buffett, indicators_shiller_pe, sentiment, news, companies_search, company_overview, fundamentals, filings · Public sink: keys_create, credits_checkout, request_data, intrinsic_value, brief, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, webhooks_list · Destructive: ai_context, research, intrinsic_value, brief, theses
